prank_description: Hector inverted the magnetic coil polarity on Kaio's scout compass right before the baton pass.
summary: Hector grinned into the ozone gale, tossing the relay baton to Kaio with an inverted magnetic charge just as a ferrofluid shear wave crested. The resulting magnetic repulsion knocked the baton off-course, sending it rocketing past Kaio to violently smack Silas's clipboard into the dark sea below.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Execute the relay handoff safely across the spire.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the Enclave against the incoming magnetosphere storm.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Master the raw energy of the planet's core.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Stormbreaker Spire rises like a fractured copper needle against a bruised, heavy sky. Below it, the dark ferrofluid sea writhes in chaotic patterns driven by raw magnetic forces. Arc-lightning flashes from the jagged iron outcroppings, momentarily painting the precarious catwalks in stuttering, violent violet light.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Stuttering violet arc-flashes illuminating churning black ferrofluid with stark silver highlights.
sensory_palette.sound: The deep, groaning hum of stressed copper lines punctuated by sharp, echoing atmospheric cracks.
sensory_palette.smell: Pungent ozone mixing with the sharp, acidic tang of vaporized iron particles.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A rhythmic, bone-rattling vibration ascending through the boots, chilled by a statically-charged wind.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: The metallic, acidic sting of charged ozone settling on the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A sparking control junction that can be bypassed to dump excess voltage.
A cresting magnetic wave that can be used to propel conductive debris.
A sheltered recess behind the main capacitor bank shielding from the wind and arcs.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To rip apart the precarious lower catwalks and disrupt the relay line.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Violently lashing the spire supports with highly magnetized, dense liquid iron.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The resulting shear wave generates a fluctuating magnetic field that heavily disrupts equipment handling.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Failure to synchronize the handoff will cause the wave to shatter the primary strut, plunging the catwalk into the abyss.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector must precisely hand off the relay baton to Kaio before the static charge overloads the node.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The extreme ferrofluid shear is wreaking havoc on all local comms and mechanical relays, threatening spire isolation.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Harnessing and surviving this intense environmental anomaly is crucial to surviving the looming macro-storm.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If the relay handoff is botched, the concentrated magnetic burst will short out the active sensory gear and dramatically worsen the shear wave.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector drops the baton straight into the ferrofluid mist, triggering an immediate catastrophic blowout of the local grid.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The handoff is fumbled; the baton is secured but Kaio sustains a severe static shock, impairing their next tactical response.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: A seamless, dynamic pass-off through the screaming wind, keeping the relay perfectly synchronized despite the prank.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: A flawless pass that simultaneously grounds the erratic static charge, temporarily subduing the shear wave and exposing a stable magnetic pathway.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector grins into the ozone gale, launching himself toward the sparking gantry and hurtling the relay baton toward Kaio.
